notes:
Summary: Large UK/EU-focused legal research platform looking to replace slow keyword search with a RAG-driven semantic layer. Primary goals: sub-100ms P90 query latency for 1–3k QPS spikes, predictable cost per query, and strict UK/EU data residency.

Key numbers: indexing target ~35–60M unique documents (court opinions, filings, contracts). Active user base ~6k monthly power users; peak concurrency expected ~1.2k. Initial POC traffic forecast: 100k queries/day, uplift to 1M q/day over 12 months.

Technical preferences / ask: prefer VPC/private deployment with control plane in EU; multi-region read replicas (IE/FR/GB) and automatic failover for London traffic. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching + quantized models for rerank stage. Will run embeddings offline (periodic reindex) with an in-memory vector cache for hot docs.

Latency & cost constraints: target P90 end-to-end <80ms for top-k retrieval + rerank (k=50->5), cost sensitivity: look to keep marginal cost/query < $0.015 for average queries, aim to use batching + prefix caching to reduce GPU token costs.

Security / compliance: SSO via SAML (Okta), tenant-level audit logs required, KMS/HSM for key custody, retention controls configurable per-corpus, SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred. Data residency requirement: primary storage and keys must remain in EU/UK.

Stakeholder quotes: "We need search that legal teams trust — reproducible, auditable, and fast. If latency is inconsistent we lose lawyers' trust." — Head of Product.

Documents shared: security questionnaire (completed v1), sample corpus (anonymized), analytics dashboard export for current search latencies.
